# Indigo Car Care Club

## What We Do
Indigo Car Care Club is a car care business in Nairobi, Kenya. We offer dry ice blasting
(also called cryogenic cleaning) and premium car detailing. Dry ice blasting is waterless
and non-conductive, so it is safe for engine bays, sensors and wiring. It lifts dirt, grease
and grime without water, chemicals or abrasive wear.

Founded by Joe, Indigo focuses on chemical science, proper surface care and elite finish
standards for vehicle owners who refuse to settle for average maintenance.

---

## Dry Ice Blasting (Industrial Area, Nairobi)
Dry ice blasting is available on Thursdays and Fridays only, from 9am, at our Industrial Area
location in Nairobi. It is not a mobile service, so customers bring their vehicle to us.
Blasting bookings need at least 48 hours notice.

### Cryogenic Blasting Packages
- Aero-Clean Engine Restoration costs KSh 22,000. It is a 100% waterless mechanical blast of the engine bay.
- Undercarriage Deep Blast and Protection costs KSh 35,000. It strips mud and grime and adds a protective sealant.
- The Power Core Combo costs KSh 49,900. It decontaminates the engine and the undercarriage.
- Bumper-to-Bumper Cryogenic Restoration costs KSh 75,000. It covers the engine, undercarriage, wheels and calipers.
- Indigo Extreme Clean costs KSh 32,000 for a sedan and KSh 34,000 for an SUV. It combines a full cabin refresh with cryogenic engine detailing.
- The Indigo Sovereign Spa costs KSh 145,000. It is our flagship cryogenic package, with a bumper-to-bumper restoration, multi-stage paint correction and Premium Graphene Ceramic Coating.

### Blasting Deposit and Cancellation
The deposit for dry ice blasting is 50 percent of the package price. Cancelling with 48 hours
notice or more earns a full refund.

---

## Standard Detailing (Mobile)
Standard detailing is a mobile service. We come to the customer's home, office or dealership
and bring our own water and power. Customers outside Nairobi should contact us before booking
so we can confirm availability.

- Indigo Cabin Refresh costs KSh 12,000 for a sedan and KSh 14,000 for an SUV. It is a full interior deep clean.
- Indigo Signature Spa costs KSh 22,000 for a sedan and KSh 24,000 for an SUV. It adds single-stage paint correction to the Cabin Refresh.

### Add-On and Standalone Services
- Pro Machine Buffing (paint correction) starts from KSh 12,000 for a sedan and KSh 15,000 for an SUV. The final price is confirmed on inspection.
- Premium Graphene Ceramic Coating costs KSh 80,000 for a sedan and KSh 90,000 for an SUV.
- Headlight Professional Restoration costs KSh 5,000 per set.

### Standard Deposit and Cancellation
The deposit for standard services is a flat KSh 2,000, deducted from the total. Cancelling with
24 hours notice or more earns a full refund.

## How to Book
Choose a package on https://indigocarcare.com/ and pay the deposit securely through Paystack.
Customers can also pay the deposit through M-Pesa Paybill 516600, Account 929787, then send
the reference on WhatsApp. We confirm bookings on WhatsApp, usually within 5 minutes.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- Indigo Car Care Club is based in Nairobi, Kenya.
- Dry ice blasting is done at the Industrial Area location only, on Thursdays and Fridays from 9am. It is not mobile.
- Standard detailing is mobile and the customer does not need to supply water or power.
- Dry ice blasting packages range from KSh 22,000 to KSh 145,000, and standard detailing starts at KSh 12,000.
- Bookings are made online with a deposit and confirmed on WhatsApp.
- The newsletter "Your Ride, Your Pride" shares detailing tips and product insights.
